summary: Jeremiah portrays threatened Zion struggling for breath. Psalm 27 joins breathing out violence with false witnesses rising against the speaker.

senses.definition: Zion gasps like a woman in labour and stretches out her hands before attackers.
A person breathing violence appears beside false witnesses. The breath image conveys the hostility of what the speaker utters.

parallels.note: The breath of violence accompanies false testimony.

note: Each word occurs once. Proverbs 6:19 has a closely similar expression with פוח, treated under puach. The spelling and parsing of the Psalm 27 form leave room for that analysis.
